name: Schizophrenia
overview: Scripture acknowledges the brokenness and complexity of the human heart, describing it as deceitful and desperately wicked (Jeremiah 17:9), yet it also offers profound comfort and hope through God's sustaining presence (Psalms 23:1; Isaiah 41:10). The Bible records Jesus' ministry of healing those afflicted with various diseases and torments, including those oppressed by demonic forces and mental distress (Matthew 4:24; Mark 6:13), demonstrating His power to restore both body and mind. Believers are called to guard their hearts diligently (Proverbs 4:23), recognizing that ultimate healing and strength come from trusting in the Lord, our Shepherd and Helper.
